name: pi-ide-commiter
description: Generates commit messages with the pi (pi.dev) agent running in the background over RPC.

commands.title: pi IDE Commiter: Generate commit message
pi IDE Commiter: Select commit model
pi IDE Commiter: Edit commit instructions
pi IDE Commiter: Restart background agent

pi-ide-commiter.piPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `pi` executable. **Empty means automatic detection** (inherited PATH, login shell, and known install directories). Only set this if detection fails — use the output of `which pi`.

pi-ide-commiter.provider.markdownDescription: pi's `--provider`. Empty uses pi's own default. Prefer the **pi IDE Commiter: Select model** command, which lists what is configured instead of making you type it.

pi-ide-commiter.model.markdownDescription: pi's `--model`. Empty uses pi's own default. Prefer the **pi IDE Commiter: Select model** command.

pi-ide-commiter.thinking.description: Thinking level. 'off' is recommended: a commit message does not need long reasoning.

pi-ide-commiter.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the pi process in RPC mode.

pi-ide-commiter.includeBody.description: Allow a multi-line body explaining why. Off generates the subject only.

pi-ide-commiter.maxSubjectLength.description: Maximum length of the commit subject.

pi-ide-commiter.language.description: Language of the commit message (e.g. english, portuguese).

pi-ide-commiter.customInstructions.markdownDescription: Extra instructions appended to the built-in prompt, e.g. `Always prefix the subject with the Jira ticket from the branch name.` Where these conflict with the built-in rules, the model is told to follow yours. Resolved per folder, so `.vscode/settings.json` gives one repository its own house style.

pi-ide-commiter.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: **Advanced.** Replaces the built-in rules entirely — style, subject length and body settings stop applying. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt. `customInstructions` is still appended on top. Your prompt must tell the model to reply with the commit message only.

pi-ide-commiter.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files with a diff; beyond that it degrades to a `--stat` summary. **0 = automatic**, derived from the model's context window.

pi-ide-commiter.maxFileDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Per-file diff budget, in chars. **0 = automatic**, derived from the model's context window.

pi-ide-commiter.maxTotalDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Total diff budget, in chars. **0 = automatic**, derived from the model's context window — more context means a more accurate commit message.

pi-ide-commiter.recentCommitCount.description: How many recent commit subjects to send so the model matches the repository's style. 0 disables it.

pi-ide-commiter.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single generation, in ms.

pi-ide-commiter.warmOnStartup.description: Start the background pi process when the workspace opens, so the first commit skips the cold start.

pi-ide-commiter.idleShutdownMs.description: Shut down the idle pi process after this long (ms). 0 = never.

pi-ide-commiter.replaceExistingMessage.description: When on, overwrite whatever is already in the commit box without asking.
